questions.platformChinese: 我上床的时间比原先打算的晚。
questions.authorEnglish: I go to bed later than I had intended.

questions.platformChinese: 如果早上需要早起，我会早点上床。
questions.authorEnglish: I go to bed early if I have to get up early in the morning.

questions.platformChinese: 晚上到了该关灯的时间，我会马上关灯。
questions.authorEnglish: If it is time to turn off the lights at night I do it immediately.

questions.platformChinese: 到了该上床的时间，我常常还在做其他事情。
questions.authorEnglish: Often I am still doing other things when it is time to go to bed.

questions.platformChinese: 当我其实想上床时，我很容易被其他事情分散注意。
questions.authorEnglish: I easily get distracted by things when I actually would like to go to bed.
I do not go to bed on time.

questions.platformChinese: 我有固定的上床时间，也会照着这个时间做。
questions.authorEnglish: I have a regular bedtime which I keep to.

questions.platformChinese: 我想按时上床，但就是没有做到。
questions.authorEnglish: I want to go to bed on time but I just don’t.

questions.platformChinese: 到了该上床的时间，我能轻松停下手头的活动。
questions.authorEnglish: I can easily stop with my activities when it is time to go to bed.
